main.summary: Provides immutable committed-content snapshots for readable segmented transfer sessions.

method.name: TryLoadSnapshot
method.summary: Attempt to load a committed-content snapshot for the specified item identifier.
method.returns: Committed snapshot when available; otherwise null.

method.name: OpenReadRange
method.summary: Open a readable stream for a specific committed-content byte range.
method.returns: Readable payload stream when available; otherwise null.
